block.createdecals.decal_block.tooltip.s: A full _copycat block_ that takes a _decal_ on each face.
createdecals.ponder.copycat_panel.header: Putting a decal on a Copycat Panel
createdecals.ponder.copycat_panel.text_2: Right-click with a Decal Stencil to put one on
createdecals.ponder.copycat_panel.text_4: Without Create: Decals, it is a plain Copycat Panel again
createdecals.ponder.copycat_step.text_1: Copycat Steps take a decal on any face
createdecals.ponder.copycat_step.text_2: Each face shows its part of the decal, so stripes run on from the blocks beside it
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_1: A full copycat block, for hulls of whole blocks
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_2: Each face takes its own decal
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_3: Set the stencil to the front layer to put a second decal on top
createdecals.ponder.decal_block.text_4: A Glow Ink Sac makes a decal glow; an Ink Sac stops it
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.header: Choosing, placing and picking up decals
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_1: Use it in the air to pick a decal, a word or a colour
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_2: Big decals spread right and down from the face you click
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_3: Sneak-click a decal to copy it into the stencil
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil.text_4: The eraser takes a decal off. Create's Clipboard copies them
createdecals.ponder.decal_stencil_deploy: A Deployer with a stencil stamps the block in front of it
With dye it recolours; with the eraser it erases
On a contraption, it stamps every block it passes
createdecals.ponder.tag.decals.descripti: Liveries for anything Create builds: decals on copycat blocks
createdecals.stencil.layer_back: Back layer: goes under a front decal; picks up and erases back decals
createdecals.stencil.layer_front: Front layer: goes over the decal already there; picks up and erases front decals
createdecals.stencil.no_decal: Choose a decal first: use the stencil in the air

createdecals.stencil.title: Decal Stencil
createdecals.stencil.undone_partly: Undone: %s of %s tiles (the rest were changed since, or are protected)
createdecals.stencil.wrong_block: %s takes no decals: use Decal Blocks or Create's Copycat Panels and Steps
